title: The Oldest Zero and Decimal Numeral System in the World: Vietnam, Cambodia or Indonesia?
version: Indonesian Journal of Mathematics and Natural Sciences 48(2), pp. 14–32
lineage: Retained original of a secondary scholarly article, not a primary transcription or direct inspection of the stone. Only the stated passages were inspected. The author’s wider priority and origin claims are contested and not adopted.

passages.note: Identifies the Talang Tuwo 606 inscription and circular zero and equates 606 Śaka with 684 CE. Wider claims about the oldest zero or its origin are not adopted.
